sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate: head dark brown, nearly oval and rather thick, with a median suture, with two circular muscle attachment scars between the ocelli and the clypeus; antennae 11—12-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 equal in length; pronotum dark brown, slightly paler than the head, the anterior margin rounded; wings transparent but the membrane dotted so that the wings look dark, the radius and media parallel and unbranched. Soldier: head long, the sides straight and parallel, the posterior margin rounded, the frons steep but not vertical, the anterior part of the frons markedly lobed; antennae 10—11-segmented, the eyes without pigment; mandibles black with strong teeth, the right mandible with distinct teeth, the left with 3. The soldier is smaller than K. temnocephalus, K. triceromegas and K. taurocephalus.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, with a few bristles; nearly oval, relatively thick; with a median suture; two circular muscle attachment scars at the midpoint between the ocelli and the clypeus. Antennae slightly paler than the head, 11—12-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 equal in length. Compound eyes medium-sized, about 1/4 of their diameter from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli medium-sized, very close to the compound eyes. Pronotum dark brown, slightly paler than the head; with a few bristles; anterior margin rounded, the sides slightly depressed; slightly narrower than the head. Wings transparent, the anterior margin, radius and media dark; the membrane dotted, which makes the wings look darker; 2 short veins run from the wing suture into the anterior margin, one distinct and one almost invisible; radius and media parallel and unbranched; the outer part of the cubitus indistinct. Abdominal tergites dark brown, concolorous with the pronotum, with a few bristles. Measurements: body length with wings 5.80—6.47 mm, body length without wings 3.40—4.00 mm; head length 0.86—0.94 mm, head width 0.76—0.77 mm; pronotal width 0.61—0.66 mm; forewing length 4.40—4.59 mm, width 1.18—1.20 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Anterior part of the head dark reddish brown, the posterior part paler; with a few short bristles; head long, the sides straight and parallel, the posterior margin rounded; frontal face steep but not vertical; the anterior part of the frons markedly lobed. Antennae pale yellow, 10—11-segmented. Eyes without pigment. Mandibles black, the teeth strong: the right mandible with distinct teeth, the left with 3 teeth. Pronotum concolorous with the posterior part of the head, with several bristles at the margins and only a few in the middle; anterior margin very shallowly concave; sides slightly depressed. Legs pale yellow, the femora stout. Abdominal tergites with a few short bristles. Measurements: body length 4.50—4.60 mm; head length 1.59—1.73 mm, head width 0.76—0.84 mm; antennal length 0.75—0.86 mm; pronotal length 0.40—0.42 mm, width 0.76—0.77 mm; left mandible length 0.57 mm. The soldier of this species is smaller than those of K. temnocephalus Silv., K. triceromegas Silv. and K. taurocephalus Silv.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Kartabo, British Guiana, known only from the type locality. The holotype is an alate and the morphotype a soldier. The description is based on numerous specimens of each caste collected by the author in six different nests at Kartabo.
